evidence: In LayerZero v2, if the execution of a message reverts, the message is considered "failed" but the nonce is still strictly ordered. Subsequent messages with higher nonces cannot be processed until the failed message is successfully executed. Since the user is blacklisted, the message will *never* succeed (unless the admin un-blacklists the user). This effectively permanently blocks the cross-chain channel.
